name: shipguard
description: AI-assisted interfaces-first pre-review, code and logic audit, process simulation, visual E2E review, mission guardrails, and optional dialogue checks.

interface.shortDescription: Review existing interfaces, audit changes, simulate behavior, guard scope
interface.longDescription: ShipGuard bundles explicit interfaces-first pre-review, static code audit, contract and invariant checking, process simulation, browser-based visual checks, mission and authority guardrails, and unified evidence dashboards. Reports expose uncertainty and keep implementation and delivery decisions with the human. Optional dialogue hooks preserve original sources, expose unavailable checks, and bound targeted corrections without granting authority.
defaultPrompt: Find existing interfaces and actual consumers before designing this change.
Check whether my recent changes are ready and propose the verification scope in plain language.
Audit this workflow or algorithm against its contracts and invariants.
Simulate the process behavior for this change.
Review visual regressions for impacted routes.
Lock this agent to my stated mission before working.
